title: Opencode Raw Log -> TSM Bridge
description: Bridge that consolidates raw opencode chat logs into the TSM ledger through CIELingo enrichment. Unlike direct runtime coupling, this path persists historical traces: each message is framed, phase-projected, and inserted into SQLite memory tables. Two pipelines: (1) historical — consolidate_raw_logs_to_tsm.py reads JSONL archives and writes to memory_ledger.db; (2) live — raw_memory_bridge.py (portal's Memory Hub) stores each prompt+CIELingo analysis+response in raw_db (/tmp/noema_raw.db) at runtime, then feeds into TSM via the same schema. KIEDYŚ: raw_memory_bridge stworzony jako osobna baza (duplikacja), do wchłonięcia do consolidate_raw_logs_to_tsm.py.

field_contract.ingest_rule: raw logs are consolidated into TSM only after CIELingo framing
